senses.gloss: m. (formed fr. עֲנָוָה) = עָנָיו, humble, forbearing, kind.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 88b:8">Snh. 88ᵇ</cite> <he>ע׳ ושפל ברך</he> forbearing and low-kneed (polite).

<cite ref="Shabbat 30b:12">Sabb. 30ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>לעולם יהא אדם ע׳ וכ׳</he> one should always be meek (patient) like Hillel, opp. <cite ref="S01702"><he>קפדן</he></cite> impatient; (<cite ref="Avot D'Rabbi Natan 15">Ab. d’R. N. ch. XV</cite> <cite ref="P00953"><he>עָנָו</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Shabbat 31a:9">Sabb. 31ᵃ</cite> <he>עי׳ הלל ינוחו וכ׳</he> O thou forbearing Hillel, blessings rest upon thy head; a. fr.—Pl. <he>עִנְוְתָנִין</he>, <cite ref="P00965"><he>עִנְוְו׳</he></cite>, <cite ref="P00965"><he>עִינְ׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 84b:19">B. Mets. 84ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>שלשה ע׳ הן</he> three persons are known for their humility.
<cite ref="Avot D'Rabbi Natan 7:2">Ab. d’R. N. ch. VII</cite> <he>בזמן … ענוותן ובני ביתו ע׳ וכ׳</he> when a man is kind (to strangers), and his household kind &c.; a. e.
